raw_problem.solution_text:
由习题 5.21(a)

$$
E _ {\mathrm {F}} = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \left(3 \rho \pi^ {2}\right) ^ {2 / 3},
$$

所以

$$
T _ {\mathrm {F}} = \frac {E _ {\mathrm {F}}}{k _ {\mathrm {B}}} = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m k _ {\mathrm {B}}} \left(3 \rho \pi^ {2}\right) ^ {2 / 3},
$$

其中

$$
\rho = \frac {\rho_ {m}}{m} = \frac {\rho_ {m}}{3 m _ {\mathrm {p}}},
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} T _ {\mathrm {F}} = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{6 m _ {\mathrm {p}} k _ {\mathrm {B}}} \left(\frac {\pi^ {2} \rho_ {m}}{m _ {\mathrm {p}}}\right) ^ {2 / 3} = \frac {\left(1 . 0 5 5 \times 1 0 ^ {- 3 4}\right) ^ {2}}{6 \times (1 . 6 7 3 \times 1 0 ^ {- 2 7}) (1 . 3 8 1 \times 1 0 ^ {- 2 3})} \left(\frac {\pi^ {2} \times 8 2}{1 . 6 7 3 \times 1 0 ^ {- 2 7}}\right) ^ {2 / 3} \\ = 4. 9 4 8 (\mathrm {K}). \\ \end{array}
$$
